# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel
> Governed geoscience coprocessor. 33+ MCP tools for subsurface evidence.
> Port: 8081. License: AGPL-3.0. Status: OPERATIONAL. Version: 2026.06.07.

## Quick Context
- **What:** Earth-truth evidence engine — petrophysics, seismic, basin analysis
- **Role:** EVIDENCE_ONLY — produces Earth evidence, never adjudicates
- **Federation:** GEOX witnesses Earth. arifOS adjudicates. Arif decides.
- **Ingress:** Cloudflare Tunnel → geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp

## Key Files
- README.md — Full human-readable narrative (716 lines)
- AGENTS.md — Agent rules, build/test commands
- GENESIS/000_MANIFESTO.md — Founding manifesto
- GENESIS/001_KILL_MAP.md — Anti-hallucination kill map
- GENESIS/002_FIRST_PRINCIPLES.md — Physics-first principles
- GENESIS/003_CONSTITUTIONAL_ALIGNMENT.md — Cross-Modal Fidelity Theorem
- GEOX_NOBEL_EUREKA_CATALOGUE.md — 6 Nobel-grade eurekas, code-mapped

## Entry Points
- src/geox_mcp/server.py — FastMCP server, dual-mode (HTTP + stdio)
- src/geox_core/ — Truth engine core (NOT agent-facing)
- src/geox_core/engines/ — Petrophysics, seismic, PINN, AC_Risk
- src/geox_core/schemas/ — Pydantic v2 Earth models
- src/geox_mcp/tools/ — Agent-facing tool surface
- src/geox_mcp/contracts/ — Tool contracts, canonical surface

## Build & Test
- Install:  pip install -e ".[dev]"  OR  uv sync --frozen
- Test:    PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/ -q --tb=short
- Smoke:   PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/smoke_test.py
- Lint:    ruff check . && ruff format .    (line length 130)
- Start:   python -m geox_mcp.server  OR  systemctl start geox-mcp
- Health:  curl http://127.0.0.1:8081/health
- Deploy:  systemctl restart geox-mcp

dim_spot_flag. Anomalous contrast detector is constitutionally governed
(ClaimTag + PhysicsGuard + AC_Risk + 888_HOLD gating).
